subject: Anchored commitment — phased milestone discount request
messages:
From: Sofia Torres <sofia@touchpoint.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@touchpoint.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: anchored commit with phased milestones (2yr)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Touchpoint's engineering and ML teams were impressed with inference latency and the cost controls you showed. We discussed a 2-year anchored commitment to Redwood if we can structure an initial prepay that eases cash flow for us while delivering a deeper term discount tied to usage milestones.

High-level ask:
- 2 year term, anchored commit of $1.2M ARR equivalent (paid 60% upfront year 1, 40% year 2)
- We want a stepped discount: 12% off list on first tranche, stepping to 20% if we hit 120% of committed usage by month 12, with a mid-term true-up.
- Request an SLA credit bucket (up to 2% of ARR) as part of commercial protections.

Can Redwood offer an exception on the discount tiering and accept the split prepay? We can provide a brief mutual action plan and aim to sign within 2–3 weeks. I attached an internal term summary (Touchpoint_Term_Summary_v1.xlsx).

Also, quick question on private deployment: will dedicated capacity be covered under the same pricing bands for commit usage or is it separate?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-minute call to iron details.

— Sofia
Sofia Torres
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Touchpoint AI
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia@touchpoint.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@touchpoint.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: anchored commit with phased milestones (2yr)

Sofia — thanks for the clear outline and the spreadsheet. We like the overall construct and can work with a split prepay. A few notes up front:

- Dedicated/private capacity counts toward committed usage for pricing as long as the customer pins a fleet in Redwood Dedicated or a Private deployment that we inventory as part of the commit. We'll call out the exact model IDs in the SOW.
- We typically avoid punitive SLA credit structures but can accept an SLA credit pool (2% ARR) as a negotiated hedge.
- For the stepped discount, I can push an approval path for an initial 15% off list on the upfront tranche, increasing to 20% once you hit 120% usage at the 12-month checkpoint. To reach 18% overall (which sits between your ask and our standard tiers) we'd need an approval for a phased milestone approach with explicit KPIs (monthly tokens, peak qps targets, and an uptime SLA).

If that approach works, I'll put together a short commercial term sheet and loop in finance/legal for an exception approval. Do you have target signature date?

Proposed next step: quick call Thursday 11/5 to confirm the milestone KPIs; I'll follow with a draft term sheet and a short MOA for approvals.

Regards,

— Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Touchpoint anchored commit — internal approval needed

Dylan — forwarding the ask. Quick guidance before you send a formal request to finance:

- Priyom: I'm comfortable taking the initial discount to 15% on the upfront tranche for sign authority. Anything beyond 17% needs a Marissa sign-off.
- Milestone clarity is required: please define the 3 checkpoint months (month 6, month 12, month 18) and the usage metrics we will verify. Attach the milestone verification method (billing + telemetry).
- If Touchpoint requests any SLA credit that counts against ARR (2% bucket), we should cap recoverable credits and include an availability gate.

Dylan — update the term sheet to call this out and include a fallback: if milestone 2 isn’t met, revert to standard commit pricing for the following 6 months.

— Priyom
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 14:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Touchpoint anchored commit — internal approval needed

Team — reviewed TP-8421 economics and risk. Approvals/adjustments: 

- Approve up to 18% effective discount spread across the two-year split, on the condition that:
  - The upfront (60%) is billed as prepaid credits and non-refundable.
  - Milestones are strictly defined: Month 6 (>=80% of monthly baseline), Month 12 (>=120% cumulative), Month 18 (>=110% rolling). Verification via billing records + KV cache telemetry export.
  - If Month 12 is missed by >15%, apply a 6-month reversion to list pricing for any overage consumption.
- SLA credit pool of up to 1.5% ARR accepted (reduced from requested 2%) — credits apply only to future invoices, not to the prepaid bucket.
- Dedicated capacity: treat as committed usage if customer confirms dedicated model tags in the SOW; any private on-prem incurs an integration fee and is not eligible for the 18% top tier.

Please capture these bullets in a one-page MOA and attach a redlined SOW. Once I have the MOA and expected signature cadence, I'll issue the final approval and finance will prepare invoicing terms.

Marissa
Head of Finance, Commercial Deals | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Torres <sofia@touchpoint.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@touchpoint.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Final commercial terms — Touchpoint anchored commit (TP-8421)

Sofia — thanks for the patience. Attached is the one-page MOA (redwood_milestone-sla-draft.pdf) and a short terms workbook summarizing the billing cadence. Key commercial points (summary):

- Term: 24 months; anchored commit equivalent $1.2M ARR
- Billing: 60% prepaid at signing (invoiced net 30), 40% invoiced at start of Month 13
- Pricing: 15% off list applied to upfront tranche; effective discount eligible up to 18% once cumulative usage checkpoints are met per the MOA
- Milestones/Verification: Month 6 (>=80% baseline), Month 12 (>=120% cumulative), Month 18 (>=110% rolling). Verification via billing + telemetry export (we include a signed telemetry access clause).
- SLA credit: up to 1.5% ARR, applied as invoice credit only; not refundable against prepaid.
- Dedicated capacity: counted toward commit if tagged in SOW; on-prem excluded from top-tier discounts.

Next steps:
1) Sofia: confirm acceptance of the MOA language and milestone KPIs by EOD Monday 11/9.
2) Upon confirmation, we'll generate the invoice for the upfront tranche and circulate the SOW for signature.

Attachment stubs included: Touchpoint_Term_Summary_v1.xlsx (customer), redwood_milestone-sla-draft.pdf (MOA), signed_moa_stub.txt (placeholder for executed MOA).

If you prefer, we can lock a 30-minute call Monday to finalize.

Best,

— Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
